scope: Q06-c is incomplete, not a product failure. In the first attempt both providers released cleanly before any follow-up, so reset was not tested. Tester approved a rerun beginning with Claude on the confirmed QA-only self-hosted environment. The same Claude workspace survived past the original idle window, a same-conversation follow-up replied normally, and the worker later exited cleanly and was deleted; the browser Enter interval overlaps the 00:59:02 T+9 sample, so strict sample-before-follow-up ordering and exact turn-completion-to-release interval remain unproven. User then deferred all Cursor testing, so the case's required Cursor follow-up/reset lane was not run. No fault, config change or manual shutdown; all QA template workspaces are gone and the dedicated QA Relay remains healthy at baseline. Keep the Claude evidence and a blocked overall verdict rather than claiming both-provider pass.
